name: Quiche
source:
A peddler who just moved to La Bête. Currently renting a room at Cafe K. She has this cool and mysterious aura, but perhaps there’s something else underneath that aloof exterior...? 
Seems she hasn’t grown a tail yet.

[From the in-game character profile]
